integrity: Full mathematical proof and a reproducible finite exact-arithmetic checker are provided; finite tests are not represented as proofs for all sizes.
scientific_limitations: Exact only on capacity-two cycles of size at least five, equal uniform pairwise coupling greater than one, and iid equiprobable initial biomasses one and two; not an empirical ecological forecast or a statement about continuous-time models. No absolute claim of priority over inaccessible or unindexed literature.
title: A two-threshold one-dimensional ecological fragmentation law with exact Gaussian fluctuations
